items.reason: The proposed guard covers an unreachable state: delegated connections use credential ID -1 (packages/lib/delegationCredential/server.ts:86), and database-backed delegation credentials are filtered out (packages/lib/delegationCredential/clientAndServer.ts:45). Cache status is queried by database credential ID (packages/features/calendar-cache/calendar-cache.repository.ts:173), so delegated connections receive cacheUpdatedAt=null (packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/connectedCalendars.handler.ts:35) and never display the delete-cache action.
